(Hint: even more camo defense.)|Beginning of Wave 24 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Shadow Boss''' is a large and fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that cannot be attacked by towers without hidden detection. Without major hidden detection defenses, this boss can easily sneak past defenses with little punishment. While it has less health than the [[Mega Slow]] and [[Giant Boss]], it is quite fast, making it a large threat. The '''Shadow Boss''' formerly appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It also appears in two [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive modes, [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. Upon its death, the [[Mystery Boss]] may spawn a '''Shadow Boss''' in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. It could also be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Shadow Boss''' has a translucent black body with a white emissive slash across its face with two lines leaking from the right side of it. It wears a black cape, has white bandages on its arms and has two pairs of translucent horns on its head, with the second pair being much smaller than the first. It also emits purple smoke from its torso. It will fade completely, then fade back into view at regular intervals. It plays a yelping sound on death. |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Shadow Boss''' is similar to the current version, except it had no horns on its head. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Shadow Boss''' is similar to the current version, except it had no face. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Shadow Boss''' was similar to the [[Ninja]] enemy as it had a dark navy skin color, black fabric legs and a dark navy fabric torso. It had a black fabric headband and cape and two pairs of black horns, one of which was much smaller than the other. It wore navy gloves and had multiple grey bandages on each arm. It had a drooling zombie face with glowing white eyes. }} ==Strategy== *At least one tower with high DPS and hidden detection is needed when the '''Shadow Boss''' debuts. **A Level 3 [[Accelerator]] or a few Level 2 or 3 [[Golden Minigunner]]s can effectively deal with at least most of the '''Shadow Boss's''' health. ***However, its charge-up time, cooldown and the fast speed of the '''Shadow Boss''' mean that placing the [[Accelerator]] where it has less coverage of the map is very risky. **An abundance of less powerful towers, like the [[Militant]], [[Warden]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Golden Soldier]], or [[Minigunner]]s can also dispatch the '''Shadow Boss'''. **It is advised not to skip Waves 22 for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode as the enemies that spawn can take damage for the '''Shadow Boss''' that debut on the following wave. *You can use the [[Warden]], [[Frost Blaster]], and [[Freezer]] to slow the '''Shadow Boss''' down, as it has a fast speed. **Be aware that due to its large size, it is slowed down for a shorter duration of time by freezing towers and the [[Warden]], compared to average-sized [[enemies]]. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot detect the '''Shadow Boss''' because it does not have hidden detection at any level. ***While the [[Sledger]], [[Cryomancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] do not have hidden detection, they can indirectly freeze or stun the '''Shadow Boss''' if there is a non-hidden enemy near it. *On Wave 25 in [[Hardcore Mode]], three '''Shadow Bosses''' will spawn, which can be dangerous if you do not have a sufficient defense. **High DPS towers, such as the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] are the best ways to counter these, although the [[Accelerator]] is preferred due to the horde of [[Lead Boss]]es spawning alongside them. **[[Ranger]]s that are buffed by a Level 4+ [[Ace Pilot]] can also be effective against them due to their high damage, though this may be more difficult to afford compared to other options. **Towers can freeze or stun them like the [[Warden]] and [[Freezer]] can be effective as they may rush past your defenses. **The Level 4+ [[Military Base]]'s ''Airstrike'' ability can severely damage the three of them if you time the ability right. *The [[Mortar]] cannot target '''Shadow Bosses''', but it can hit them through splash damage, if another detectable enemy is near the '''Shadow Boss'''. **The [[Rocketeer]] can be effective against the '''Shadow Boss''' because of its hidden detection and high DPS. *The [[Commander]] is recommended against the '''Shadow Boss''' as it boosts the firerate of towers and can deal extra damage to the '''Shadow Boss''' itself. *A Level 4+ [[Ace Pilot]] can give hidden detection to towers that do not have it, allowing them to deal damage to the '''Shadow Boss'''. **The tower must be in range of the [[Ace Pilot]]'s runway for them to receive hidden detection. *Slow firing towers such as the [[Hunter]] are less effective against the '''Shadow Boss''' due to its speed. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} ShadowBoss2.png|Third version (8 May 2021 – 23 March 2022) NewShadowBoss.png|Second version (29
